missionEventData.data2: Fresh from their stunning success against the Invincible, the Alliance has found renewed hope in their struggle against the Empire. Joined by new allies from Sullust and Mon Calamari, Ace pilot Keyan Farlander and the Rebel Alliance must now continue the fight from their new base on Yavin 4. But rumour has it that the Empire has a secret project of such awesome destructive power that it could destroy not only the Alliance but resistance itself.

missionEventData.data1: Two rebel prisoners believed to be carrying important information have made a daring escape from the imperial prison at Stars’ End aboard the transport Genue. Unfortunately our spies report that their escape has already been communicated across Imperial channels and the Genue is standing by for boarding. Command has authorised a daring rescue mission. The Bixby will jump in and dock with the Genue while the Redemption draws fire from any enemy vessels. Your task is to keep any fighters off the Bixby and the Redemption. Good luck pilot.
There's a stormtrooper transport going for the Genue.
Looks like the Intrepid beat us, I'm reading two Tie's on patrol.
This is the Bixby we're moving in to dock with the Genue.
Ship secured, keep us covered while we move to the jump point.
Okay, Red Squadron, the Bixby and the Genue are out, cover the Redemption while she heads to the jump point.
This is the Redemption, we're going to try and draw the Intrepid's fire away from the Bixby.
Red Squadron. The Redemption has jumped. Disengage and make a break for the jump point.
Squad is moving to take control of the Genue now.
Those stormtroopers are giving us a hard time. Expect a delay.
Threat successfully contained. Continuing to move to the bridge.
Well down Red Squadron. Our people are thankful for the rescue. And our teams are processing their information now. So get some food and some rest, we want to be ready to respond within twelve hours…
I'm reading a squadron of Tie launching.
Thanks six! This is why we're here pilots! Look lively and give them hell!
The Intrepid is launching more Ties. Keep it together Red Squadron, we're almost done!
Those Stormtroopers won't be bothering our boarding party.
This is one. I couldn't stop the transport. Looks like our boarding crew will have to deal with them.
This is six. That Transport managed to slip passed me.
This is two. That Transport managed to slip passed me.
Don't worry six. The boarding crew will handle it.
Don't worry Two. The boarding crew will handle it.
Red Squadron. Head to the jump point.
This is Red Leader. We're on our way.
